title: Neutrino Phone
one_liner: Compare light-speed latency through Earth's core versus around its surface between any two cities.
headline: Pick two cities and watch a neutrino beam racing straight through Earth's core beat a fiber signal curving over the surface — with exact light-speed math for both.

episode.title: Why Altman Says "Accept Some Bad Things Happening" and What It Means for AI Safety | MOONSHOTS #301

history.summary: A clean, self-contained physics toy that nails the core idea: real haversine/chord geometry, accurate light-speed latency, an animated cutaway race, and unusually thorough honesty framing (tag, disclaimer, README "what's real" section, footer credit). The one loose thread is a duplicated, unused `data/cities.json` file and a label ("Through-core route") that slightly overstates how close the straight-line path actually gets to the core for nearby city pairs.
